points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake source and documented build/reproduction scripts are committed; evaluator did not repeat a clean solver build.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: All eight delivered raw packages pass the explicit output validator.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Substantial modular C++ solver, scripts, tests, and report source are present.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal evidence of an external solver wrapper was found; trust policy applied.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case controls and mesh data are handled through inputs rather than two filename-only branches.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Source and report document MPI/METIS rank studies and independent checks.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Strong verification tooling is present; independent clean solver rerun was not required.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Terminal response documents 270 unit assertions and contract/physics checks.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: 452 raw/study artifacts and unreferenced figures required index-only curation.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
